name: itsa-foreign-property-losses
title: A foreign property loss: carried forward only
description: A signed-in walk through Making Tax Digital for Income Tax's losses and claims for a foreign property business: sign in, take out Resident, get HMRC's access for the year, then set a landlord's loss to carry forward, since carry-back is not on offer for a property business.
